name: Kyoto ~Omoi wa Watatsukibashi o Koete~
original_name: 京都 ～想いは渡月橋をこえて～
source:
In autumn thoughts change into love feeling. This is a love story between high school students who live in Kyoto. Where will autumn Kyoto atmosphere bring them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
